"""Single installed QA preparation/Trial, no model dispatch or qualification."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

assert os.geteuid() == 0 and os.uname().nodename == 'anvil-qa-v1'
image = sys.argv[1]
assert re.fullmatch(r'us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/adi-anvil-mvp-2026/anvil-qa-v1/kyc-runtime@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}', image)
manifest_raw = Path('/tmp/forge-release-e49e149/release.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(manifest_raw).hexdigest() == sys.argv[2]
release = json.loads(manifest_raw)
assert release['revision'] == 'e49e149d814d43b8028d11cfe95e7398acbf8318'
assert release['source_sha256'] == 'c26a7965e3ee215aa74e495c5341c15a2e0423f3952a1799111e8eef688201e4'
assert image == release['images']['kyc-runtime']
root = Path('/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1/runtime-functional')
private = root / 'probe-config-e49e149-v1'
proof = root / 'harbor-proof'
proxy = root / 'probe-pg-proxy-e49e149-v1'
original = root / 'probe-config-d9f3d6a-v4'
assert not proxy.exists()
for phase in ('prepare', 'trial'):
    p = subprocess.run(['docker', 'inspect', 'forge-native-' + phase + '-e49e149-v1'], capture_output=True, timeout=15)
    assert p.returncode == 1 and b'no such' in p.stderr.lower()
pins = {
    '/tmp/forge-release-e49e149/native-proxy.py': 'd0be9fb2cdc6a2da032dee4f73775400c78f66a1afd67d768063e6931dcb57c4',
    '/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1/runtime-functional/probe-config-d9f3d6a-v4/scheduler.json': '649049eaed2744717662a2ac2639e07b2d1a4058f3032f5624099e91eb64cd5f',
    '/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1/runtime-functional/probe-config-d9f3d6a-v4/request.json': '7b0ae1983ff7b1900d3567819897303e40faa14e20971373ef15f8d74f2f418a',
}
for name, pin in pins.items():
    p = Path(name)
    assert p.resolve() == p and p.stat().st_uid == 0 and not p.stat().st_mode & 0o022
    assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == pin
metadata = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'image', 'inspect', image], timeout=15))[0]
assert metadata['Config']['Labels']['org.opencontainers.image.revision'] == 'e49e149d814d43b8028d11cfe95e7398acbf8318'
private.mkdir(mode=0o700)
shutil.copyfile(original / 'scheduler.json', private / 'scheduler.json')
(private / 'scheduler.json').chmod(0o600)
request = json.loads((original / 'request.json').read_bytes())
request['docker_host'] = 'unix:///run/docker.sock'
request['database_provider']['path'] = str(private / 'scheduler.json')
with os.fdopen(os.open(private / 'request.json', os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600), 'w') as out:
    json.dump(request, out, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))
proxy_source = Path('/tmp/forge-release-e49e149/native-proxy.py').read_text()
old = '/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1/runtime-functional/probe-pg-proxy-d9f3d6a'
assert proxy_source.count(old) == 1
proxy_source = proxy_source.replace(old, str(proxy))
program = private / 'unix-transport.py'
program.write_text(proxy_source)
program.chmod(0o600)
transport = None
owned = {}

def command(name):
    return ['docker', 'create', '--pull=never', '--name', name, '--label', 'io.adi.forge.scope=owned-native-control',
            # Trusted root operator already owns the daemon UDS; it must inspect
            # real host PID1's namespace. No such access reaches either actor
            # or verifier Compose profiles, which remain cap-drop ALL/none-net.
            '--read-only', '--user', '0:0', '--cap-drop', 'ALL', '--cap-add', 'SYS_PTRACE',
            '--security-opt', 'no-new-privileges', '--security-opt', 'apparmor=unconfined',
            '--pid', 'host', '--uts', 'host', '--userns', 'host', '--cgroupns', 'host', '--network', 'none',
            '--memory', '1536m', '--pids-limit', '256', '--cpus', '2',
            '--tmpfs', '/tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=128m',
            '--mount', 'type=bind,src=' + str(proof) + ',dst=' + str(proof),
            '--mount', 'type=bind,src=' + str(private) + ',dst=' + str(private) + ',readonly',
            '--mount', 'type=bind,src=' + str(proxy) + ',dst=/var/run/forge-probe-postgresql,readonly',
            '--mount', 'type=bind,src=/run/docker.sock,dst=/run/docker.sock,readonly',
            '--mount', 'type=bind,src=/usr/bin/docker,dst=/usr/bin/docker,readonly',
            '--mount', 'type=bind,src=/usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose,dst=/usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose,readonly',
            '-e', 'ANVIL_ENV=local', '-e', 'WEB_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3202',
            '-e', 'ANVIL_LIVE_PROVIDERS_ENABLED=false', '-e', 'ANVIL_HARBOR_LIVE_PROVIDERS_ENABLED=false',
            '-e', 'ANVIL_REAL_EMAIL_ENABLED=false', '--entrypoint', '/opt/anvil-runtime/bin/python', image, '-I', '-B']

def retain(name, raw):
    with os.fdopen(os.open(private / name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600), 'wb') as out:
        out.write(raw)
        out.flush()
        os.fsync(out.fileno())
    fd = os.open(private, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

def run(phase, arguments):
    name = 'forge-native-' + phase + '-e49e149-v1'
    created = subprocess.run(command(name) + arguments, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    retain(phase + '.create.private.stderr', created.stderr)
    assert created.returncode == 0, 'Unknown creation acknowledgement; reconcile exact name'
    identifier = created.stdout.decode().strip()
    assert re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}', identifier)
    owned[phase] = identifier
    retain(phase + '.id.json', json.dumps({'id': identifier, 'image': image}).encode())
    result = subprocess.run(['docker', 'start', '--attach', identifier], capture_output=True, timeout=430)
    retain(phase + '.stdout', result.stdout)
    retain(phase + '.stderr', result.stderr)
    assert result.returncode == 0, 'Native control failed; retained without replay'
    return json.loads(result.stdout)

retain('intent.json', json.dumps({'image': image, 'inputs': pins, 'model_calls_authorized': 0}, sort_keys=True).encode())
try:
    log = os.open(private / 'transport.private.log', os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    transport = subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/python3', str(program)], stdout=log, stderr=log, start_new_session=True)
    os.close(log)
    for _ in range(30):
        if (proxy / '.s.PGSQL.5432').exists():
            break
        assert transport.poll() is None, 'AF_UNIX transport failed; private logs retained'
        time.sleep(0.1)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('AF_UNIX transport startup deadline')

    diagnostic = """import json,traceback
from anvil.golden_kyc_probe_prepare import prepare
try:
 print(json.dumps(prepare(%r)))
except Exception as e:
 print(json.dumps({'error_type':type(e).__name__,'message':str(e),'frames':[{'file':f.filename,'line':f.lineno,'function':f.name} for f in traceback.extract_tb(e.__traceback__)]}))
 raise SystemExit(1)
""" % str(private / 'request.json')
    prepared = run('prepare', ['-c', diagnostic])
    assert prepared['status'] == 'prepared_not_launched' and prepared['qualification_granted'] is False
    # This job is launched once. Failure/ambiguity is retained and never replayed.
    trial_diagnostic = """import json,traceback
from anvil.golden_kyc_probe import run
try:
 print(json.dumps(run(%r)))
except Exception as e:
 print(json.dumps({'error_type':type(e).__name__,'frames':[{'file':f.filename,'line':f.lineno,'function':f.name} for f in traceback.extract_tb(e.__traceback__)]}))
 raise SystemExit(1)
""" % prepared['job_id']
    run('trial', ['-m', 'anvil.golden_kyc_probe', '--job', prepared['job_id']])
finally:
    cleanup = {}
    for phase in ('prepare', 'trial'):
        name = 'forge-native-' + phase + '-e49e149-v1'
        try:
            p = subprocess.run(['docker', 'inspect', owned.get(phase, name)], capture_output=True, timeout=15)
            if phase not in owned and p.returncode == 1 and b'no such' in p.stderr.lower():
                cleanup[phase] = {'not_created': True}
                continue
            info = json.loads(p.stdout)[0]
            assert info['Name'] == '/' + name and info['Config']['Image'] == image
            assert info['Config']['Labels'].get('io.adi.forge.scope') == 'owned-native-control'
            if phase in owned:
                assert info['Id'] == owned[phase]
            else:
                retain(phase + '.reconciled-id.json', json.dumps({'id': info['Id'], 'image': image}).encode())
            if info['State']['Running']:
                subprocess.run(['docker', 'stop', '--time', '1', info['Id']], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=6)
            terminal = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'inspect', info['Id']], timeout=15))[0]
            assert not terminal['State']['Running'] and not terminal['State']['Restarting'] and terminal['State']['Pid'] == 0
            cleanup[phase] = {'id': info['Id'], 'terminal': True, 'exit_code': terminal['State']['ExitCode']}
        except BaseException as error:
            cleanup[phase] = {'unknown_retained': True, 'error_type': type(error).__name__}
    try:
        if proxy.exists():
            (proxy / 'STOP').touch(mode=0o600, exist_ok=True)
        if transport is not None:
            try:
                transport.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                transport.terminate()
                try:
                    transport.wait(timeout=3)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    transport.kill()
                    transport.wait(timeout=3)
            cleanup['transport'] = {'reaped': transport.poll() is not None, 'exit_code': transport.returncode}
    except BaseException as error:
        cleanup['transport'] = {'unknown_retained': True, 'error_type': type(error).__name__}
    retain('cleanup.json', json.dumps(cleanup, sort_keys=True).encode())
assert all(not v.get('unknown_retained') for v in cleanup.values()), 'Incomplete cleanup; no qualification'
assert all(v.get('not_created') or v.get('exit_code') == 0 for k, v in cleanup.items() if k != 'transport')
print(json.dumps({'status': 'observed_not_qualified', 'job_id': prepared['job_id'], 'evidence': str(private), 'cleanup': cleanup, 'qualification_granted': False}))
